from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,csv,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from decimal import Decimal
root=Path.cwd()
d=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_coupon_jan2024_source_qualification_v1'
sources=d/'sources'
assert not (d/'result.json').exists(),'本实验已经有裁决，不覆盖'
rows=json.loads((d/'合格固定利率付息券公告候选.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['rows']
now=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
tenors=['2-Year','3-Year','5-Year','7-Year','10-Year','20-Year','30-Year']
plans={
 'Aug-23':[45,42,46,36,38,16,23],
 'Sep-23':[48,44,49,37,35,13,20],
 'Oct-23':[51,46,52,38,35,13,20],
 'Nov-23':[54,48,55,39,40,16,24],
 'Dec-23':[57,50,58,40,37,13,21],
 'Jan-24':[60,52,61,41,37,13,21],
}
table={'unit':'billion USD','source_url':'https://home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/qr-q4-2023-policy-statement.PNG','source_path':str((sources/'20231101季度计划表.PNG').relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/'),
 'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256((sources/'20231101季度计划表.PNG').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'extraction':'已读取官方季度安排表的完整原图，手工转录固定七列；FRN列不进入本固定利率券比较。',
 'tenors':tenors,'months':plans,'date_of_quarterly_statement':'2023-11-01',
 'clock_context':'财政部10月30日邮件预告11月1日08:30美东发布融资细节；保留为预告时刻代理，不冒充当天收件凭证。',
 'scheduled_release_us_eastern':'2023-11-01T08:30:00-04:00','scheduled_release_shanghai':'2023-11-01T20:30:00+08:00',
 'historical_first_vintage_verified':False,'all_table_columns_and_rows_visually_checked':True}
(d/'季度提前计划_原图转录.json').write_text(json.dumps(table,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
months={name:dict(zip(tenors,vals)) for name,vals in plans.items()}
out=[]
for row in rows:
    text=(sources/row['pdf_filenm_announcemt']).with_suffix('.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    money=lambda label: Decimal(re.search(label+r'[^\n]*?\$([0-9,]+)',text).group(1).replace(',',''))
    pdf_amount=money('Offering Amount')
    api_amount=Decimal(row['offering_amt'])
    node=ET.parse(sources/row['xml_filenm_announcemt']).getroot()
    xml={x.tag.split('}')[-1]:(x.text or '').strip() for x in node.iter() if x.text and x.text.strip()}
    xml_amount=Decimal(xml['OfferingAmount'])*Decimal(10)**9
    assert pdf_amount==api_amount==xml_amount
    assert xml['AnnouncementDate']==row['announcemt_date']
    assert xml['AuctionDate']==row['auction_date'] and xml['IssueDate']==row['issue_date'] and xml['MaturityDate']==row['maturity_date']
    reopening='(Reopening)' in text
    assert reopening==(row['reopening']=='Yes')==(xml['ReOpeningIndicator']=='Y')
    assert xml['InflationIndexSecurity']=='N' and xml['FloatingRate']=='N'
    match=re.search(r'Embargoed Until (\d{1,2}:\d{2}) A\.M\.\s+CONTACT[^\n]*\n([A-Z][a-z]+ \d{2}, \d{4})',text)
    assert match,'未找到打印公布时刻'+row['cusip']
    release=datetime.strptime(match.group(2)+' '+match.group(1),'%B %d, %Y %H:%M').replace(tzinfo=ZoneInfo('America/New_York'))
    assert release.date().isoformat()==row['announcemt_date']
    pdf_maturing=money('Estimated Amount of Maturing Coupon Securities Held by the Public')
    pdf_soma=money('SOMA Holdings Maturing')
    maturity_line=re.search(r'^Maturing Date ([A-Z][a-z]+ \d{2}, \d{4})$',text,re.M).group(1)
    maturity_date=datetime.strptime(maturity_line,'%B %d, %Y').date().isoformat()
    assert pdf_maturing==Decimal(xml['MatureSecurityAmount']) and pdf_soma==Decimal(xml['SOMAHoldings']) and maturity_date==xml['MaturingDate']
    assert 'SOMA Amounts Included in Offering Amount No' in text
    assert re.search(r'FIMA Amounts Included in Offering Amount(?: \d+)? Yes',text)
    plan=Decimal(months['Jan-24'][row['original_security_term']])*Decimal(10)**9
    out.append({
      'cusip':row['cusip'],'original_tenor':row['original_security_term'],'remaining_term':row['security_term'],
      'new_or_reopening':'REOPENING' if reopening else 'NEW_ISSUE',
      'prior_plan_date':'2023-11-01','prior_plan_amount_usd':str(plan),'announcement_amount_usd':str(api_amount),
      'announcement_minus_prior_plan_usd':str(api_amount-plan),
      'printed_release_us_eastern':release.isoformat(),'printed_release_shanghai':release.astimezone(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),
      'auction_date':row['auction_date'],'issue_date':row['issue_date'],'maturity_date':row['maturity_date'],
      'public_coupon_maturing_estimate_usd':str(pdf_maturing),'public_coupon_maturing_date':maturity_date,
      'soma_maturing_usd':str(pdf_soma),'soma_included_in_offering_amount':False,'fima_included_in_offering_amount':True,
      'original_pdf':row['pdf_filenm_announcemt'],'original_xml':row['xml_filenm_announcemt'],
      'scope_and_footnotes_visually_checked':True,'pdf_api_xml_checked':True,'printed_clock_is_contemporaneous_receipt':False,
      'historical_first_vintage_verified':False,
    })
assert len(out)==7 and all(Decimal(r['announcement_minus_prior_plan_usd'])==0 for r in out)
with (d/'七券公告与提前计划对齐.csv').open('w',encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(out[0]));w.writeheader();w.writerows(out)
roots={}
maturity_buckets={}
for r in out:
    roots.setdefault(r['printed_release_shanghai'],[]).append(r['cusip'])
    key=r['public_coupon_maturing_date']
    b=maturity_buckets.setdefault(key,{'maturing_date':key,'public_coupon_maturing_estimate_usd':r['public_coupon_maturing_estimate_usd'],'soma_maturing_usd':r['soma_maturing_usd'],'occurrences':0,'cusips':[]})
    assert b['public_coupon_maturing_estimate_usd']==r['public_coupon_maturing_estimate_usd'] and b['soma_maturing_usd']==r['soma_maturing_usd']
    b['occurrences']+=1;b['cusips'].append(r['cusip'])
naive=sum(Decimal(r['public_coupon_maturing_estimate_usd']) for r in out)
dedup=sum(Decimal(b['public_coupon_maturing_estimate_usd']) for b in maturity_buckets.values())
maturity_report={
 'status':'CONFIRMED_REPEATED_MATURITY_BUCKETS_NOT_NET_LIQUIDITY',
 'buckets':list(maturity_buckets.values()),
 'naive_sum_if_seven_rows_added_usd':str(naive),'deduplicated_public_coupon_maturity_estimates_usd':str(dedup),
 'overcount_if_rows_added_usd':str(naive-dedup),
 'net_liquidity_computed':False,
 'boundary':'本范围排除TIPS/FRN，但到期public coupon桶可能含这些券；SOMA与FIMA口径也不同，另有Bill、利息和财政现金收支。不能用七券gross减这个到期总桶就声称全市场净资金抽离。',
}
(d/'重复到期桶与净流动性边界.json').write_text(json.dumps(maturity_report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
october=plans['Oct-23'];january=plans['Jan-24']
increments=[j-o for j,o in zip(january,october)]
decomposition={'october_reference_fixed_coupon_gross_billion_usd':sum(october),'january_planned_fixed_coupon_gross_billion_usd':sum(january),
 'gross_increase_billion_usd':sum(increments),'increments_by_original_tenor_billion_usd':dict(zip(tenors,increments)),
 'two_to_seven_year_increase_billion_usd':sum(increments[:4]),'ten_to_thirty_year_increase_billion_usd':sum(increments[4:]),
 'two_to_seven_share_of_gross_increase':sum(increments[:4])/sum(increments),
 'effect_on_yields_or_stock_returns_identified':False,
 'interpretation':'供给增量主要集中原2—7年券，不将总规模等同长端期限风险或折现率冲击；此为2023-11-01已公开计划构成，不是1月新增意外。'}
(d/'供给构成原因说明.json').write_text(json.dumps(decomposition,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
render=json.loads((d/'原公告渲染回执.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
for p in render['pages']:
    p['visually_checked']=True
    p['visual_result']='完整一页：金额、时刻、新发续发、到期/SOMA/FIMA以及脚注清晰，原件未改写。'
render['visual_review_at']=now
(d/'原公告渲染回执.json').write_text(json.dumps(render,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
result={
 'study_id':'510300_TREASURY_COUPON_JAN2024_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_V1','experiment_id':'E4_COUPON_SOURCE','completed_at':now,
 'status':'COMPLETED_FIXED_MONTH_ALL_COUPON_AMOUNTS_PREANNOUNCED',
 'classification':'PROGRESS_SOURCE_AND_TIMING_RESOLVED_INCREMENTAL_AUCTION_AMOUNT_NOT_ESTABLISHED',
 'complete_month_records':38,'qualified_fixed_rate_coupon_securities':7,'excluded_records':31,
 'new_issues':sum(r['new_or_reopening']=='NEW_ISSUE' for r in out),'reopenings':sum(r['new_or_reopening']=='REOPENING' for r in out),
 'announcement_original_pdfs':7,'announcement_original_xmls':7,'official_quarterly_sources':3,'pdf_pages_visually_read':7,
 'distinct_individual_announcement_roots':len(roots),'individual_announcement_roots':roots,
 'earlier_quarterly_policy_roots':1,'prior_quarterly_statement_date':'2023-11-01',
 'all_seven_amounts_match_prior_plan':True,'amount_changes_vs_prior_plan':0,
 'planned_fixed_coupon_gross_billion_usd':285,
 'maturity_pool_count':len(maturity_buckets),'same_maturity_pool_repeated_in_rows':True,
 'gross_plan_source_qualified_for_fixed_month_only':True,'fixed_month_release_clock_reconstructed':True,
 'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'full_period_coverage_qualified':False,
 'incremental_individual_auction_amount_surprise_expression':'NOT_RUN_ZERO_NEW_AMOUNT_INFORMATION_IN_REGISTERED_MONTH',
 'surprise_relative_to_market_expectations_computed':False,
 'net_liquidity_computed':False,'new_price_or_stock_returns_loaded':False,'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,
 'account_net_sharpe':None,'account_net_cagr':None,'goal_achieved':False,'orders_authorized':False,
 'new_repository_code_edits':0,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,
 'conclusion':'七份逐次公告规模全部由11月季度计划提前覆盖；1月不能将三次再公告写成新规模意外。上游季度计划和供给构成事实可研究，但未证明股票优势。两个到期桶去重且范围不匹配，不计算伪净流动性。',
 'next_research_question':'优先检查财政部历史季度一级交易商发行规模调查能否提供事前预期分布及公布时点，识别季度计划相对机构预期的变化；不是重复抓1月公告或仅增加gross规模字段。若无匹配预期，不能称市场意外。',
}
(d/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'完成':result['status'],'合格券':7,'原PDF页':7,'同刻公告根':len(roots),'新规模偏差':0,'季度gross十亿美元':285,'供给增量短中期占比':decomposition['two_to_seven_share_of_gross_increase'],'重复到期桶':len(maturity_buckets),'拟合':0,'账户':0},ensure_ascii=False))
